output.reason: The change comes from a computed CRD storage-version diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install manifests [ev-782bc47d120d] [ev-c2c6c790d6b2]. The change text says existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 and still work, and that migration is needed only before a later release removes v1beta2. Nothing fails, gets rejected or must be migrated in this release, so calling this mandatory migration-required work over-claims. It is a deprecation (review class).

correction.statement: Storage version of imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io changes v1beta2 → v1. v1beta2 is deprecated: objects stored as v1beta2 keep working now but must be migrated before a later release removes v1beta2.

consequence.statement: Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until rewritten and keep working in this release. They will break when a later release removes v1beta2 unless storage is migrated to v1 first.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta2, run a storage version migration for imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io (re-write all ImageRepository objects) and update status.storedVersions.
